paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.18% on average, with Dow Jones strongest (+1.60%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-4.61%). Brent crude changed +4.53% to 110.86. Gold changed +0.90% to 4,145.0. Bitcoin changed +2.27% to 83,350.1172. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.117%, a relative move of -1.92%. Among the firms tracked, Bank of America (-6.15%) and BlackRock (+5.87%) moved the most.
